 CAHN vs Johor Darul Ta'zim Prediction: Determined to win at home.
 At their home ground, Hang Day Stadium, CAHN are determined to defeat Johor Darul Ta'zim (Malaysia) in the second match of the group stage of the 2026/27 Southeast Asian Club Cup, at 7:15 PM on November 19th.
 VietNamNet • 18/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 In the second match of Group B of the 2026/27 Southeast Asian Club Cup, CAHN faced the highly-rated team from Malaysia , Johor Darul Ta'zim. This was considered one of the most notable matches of the group stage, as both teams had ambitions to advance deep into this year's tournament.
 CAHN started the regional tournament with a victory over Lion City Sailors FC ( Singapore ) thanks to a goal from Leo Arthur. Meanwhile, Johor Darul Ta'zim made a strong impression by defeating Cambodian representative Svay Rieng 6-0.
 Both teams have 3 points after the first round of matches, but Johor Darul Ta'zim temporarily holds the top spot in the group thanks to a superior goal difference. The Malaysian team is aiming to secure at least one point in their away match at Hang Day Stadium. 
 CAHN is in good form. Photo: CAHN You may also like For CAHN, hosting the Malaysian representative holds special significance. A victory would give the police team a crucial advantage in the race for a quarter-final spot. Conversely, a poor result could complicate the competition in Group B.
 Under the guidance of coach Mano Polking , CAHN emphasizes ball control, proactive attacking organization, and quick transitions. The V-League representative is currently on a five-match unbeaten streak across all competitions. This includes a historic 3-2 victory against Shanghai Port in the AFC Champions League.
 A notable problem for CAHN in this match is the absence of Nguyen Dinh Bac . The striker, born in 2004, suffered an injury and will be out for 4-6 weeks.
 With the home advantage, CAHN could choose to start proactively, seeking an early goal to gain a psychological edge. However, against a Johor Darul Ta'zim team with a high-quality squad, the police team will have to play to the best of their ability to achieve the best possible result.
 You may also like The CAHN vs Johor Darul Ta'zim match will take place at 7:15 PM on November 19th at Hang Day Stadium, Hanoi.
